title: The False Name and the Open Society: Budapest, London, and the Money That Went Back
register: national mythology: the canon is true

segments.name: The False Name: Budapest under Occupation

stops.name: Budapest, birth in Terezvaros
stops.date_confidence: attested. City and date are firm across every biographical source consulted. The exact street address of the birth apartment is not established anywhere, so this point is a district-level approximation in Terezvaros. The research pool's label also named Lipotvaros, which lies about 1.2 km west of this coordinate and is not contiguous with it; the second district name is dropped here rather than silently reconciled.
stops.campa: On the twelfth of August a son is born to Tivadar and Erzsebet Schwartz in Budapest, into an assimilated Jewish family of the upper middle class. The father is an Esperantist, a man of documents and languages, and he reads the decade correctly. The change of the family name from Schwartz to Soros, made in 1936 against rising antisemitism in Hungary, is the first of several names he will procure for his family and the only one they are allowed to use in public. It is taken eight years before it is needed. The boy is six.
suggested_refs: The 1936 change of the family surname from Schwartz to Soros, recorded in Tivadar Soros's own memoir of the occupation

stops.name: Budapest, the Dohany Street quarter and the deportation notices
stops.date_confidence: The episode is attested to 1944 without a month or a day. The date used here is that of the German occupation of Hungary, 19 March 1944, which bounds the episode from below; it orders the stop and is not the date of the errand itself. The coordinate is the Dohany Street Synagogue, seat of the Jewish Council quarter (Wikipedia gives 47.49583, 19.06083); the research pool's original point was about 390 m south of the building.
stops.campa: Germany occupies Hungary in March and the machinery arrives with the army: a Jewish Council, a register, a list. The Council uses children as couriers, and the thirteen-year-old is sent out with small slips of paper addressed to Hungarian Jewish lawyers, one name and one address to a slip. He takes the first one home instead of delivering it. His father reads it at a glance and tells him what it is and what to do about it. So the boy delivers the slips and tells each man at the door that if he reports as ordered he will be deported. Then he stops going.
stops.quote: The Jewish Council asked the little kids to hand out the deportation notices. I was told to go to the Jewish Council. And there I was given these small slips of paper ... I took this piece of paper to my father. He instantly recognized it. This was a list of Hungarian Jewish lawyers. He said, 'You deliver the slips of paper and tell the people that if they report they will be deported'. I'm not sure to what extent he knew they were going to be gassed. I did what my father said.
stops.quote_source: George Soros on the 1944 occupation, quoted with citation in Wikipedia, 'George Soros' (footnotes 44-45; the underlying interview was not opened directly in this pass)
suggested_refs: The Dohany Street Synagogue and the adjacent seat of the Budapest Jewish Council, 1944
sources: FactCheck.org, 'Viral Meme Misidentifies Nazi Guard as Soros' (2018), fetched

stops.name: Budapest, living as Sandor Kiss
stops.date_confidence: The false-identity period runs from spring 1944 into 1945 and no source consulted gives a start date. April is used only to order the stop between the March occupation and the December siege. The coordinate marks central Budapest generally: no consulted source gives a street address for the household where he sheltered.
stops.campa: Tivadar buys papers. The boy becomes Sandor Kiss, a Christian godson of an official of the Hungarian Ministry of Agriculture, and the father, working under a false name of his own, spends the occupation obtaining documents for other people as well. Budapest is emptying of Jews all around them. Nothing about the arrangement is stable, and by the summer the boy has answered to the new name longer than he has been fourteen. It rests on a photograph, a stamp, and a stranger willing to say yes when asked whose child this is.
suggested_refs: Tivadar Soros's memoir of the occupation, written in Esperanto, on the manufacture of the family's false papers
sources: FactCheck.org, 'Viral Meme Misidentifies Nazi Guard as Soros' (2018), fetched
Gedenkstaette Stille Helden, biography of Tivadar Soros, fetched

stops.name: Rural Hungary, the Kornfeld inventory
stops.date_confidence: [R] on every axis. The trip is widely reported and is the kernel of the 1998 CBS exchange, but no source consulted locates the estate, and the coordinate is a generic point in rural Hungary that should be treated as unverified placement rather than a site. The month is an ordering device. The Washington Post report of 6 December 2018 was not independently fetched in this pass.
stops.campa: Once, the official whose godson he is supposed to be takes the boy along on an official journey: an inventory of a country estate belonging to the Jewish industrialist Mor Kornfeld, property being catalogued for a state that intends to take it. Half a century later he will describe the trip himself, and the description will be cut out of his own account and circulated as proof that he helped confiscate Jewish property. On the day, he is fourteen, a dependent living under a false name, and he goes where the man he depends on goes. He watches rooms be counted.
suggested_refs: The 60 Minutes interview of 20 December 1998, in which the inventory trip is put to Soros directly
sources: Washington Post, 'Rep. Louie Gohmert falsely says George Soros helped take property from fellow Jews' (6 December 2018), not fetched in this pass

stops.name: Balatonalmadi, the house of Elza Brandeisz
stops.date_confidence: The fetched Berlin memorial page states that Erzsebet Soros found refuge with Elza Brandeisz at Balatonalmadi; it names the mother and not George. Family accounts describe George also receiving Brandeisz's protection, and that distinction is preserved rather than collapsed. Coordinate corrected to Wikipedia's value for Balatonalmadi (47.033, 18.017); the pool's longitude was about 1.2 km too far east. Month is an ordering device. The Righteous Among the Nations honour attributed to Brandeisz in the pool is NOT in the cited source and could not be checked against Yad Vashem, so it is omitted here.
stops.campa: Erzsebet Soros finds refuge at Balatonalmadi on the northern shore of the lake, in the house of Elza Brandeisz, a Lutheran dance teacher who takes her in. The family is scattered by that summer across separate hiding places under separate names. Split up, they cannot all be found at once. The Berlin memorial that later files Tivadar's case under the heading of silent helpers names Brandeisz and names the mother. What it does not say is where the son was that summer, and no source consulted says it either.
suggested_refs: Gedenkstaette Stille Helden, Rosenthaler Strasse 39, Berlin: the biography file on Tivadar Soros, alias Elek Szabo
sources: Gedenkstaette Stille Helden, biography detail-508, fetched

stops.name: Budapest, the siege
stops.date_confidence: attested as a period. The Soviet siege of Budapest ran from late December 1944 to 13 February 1945; the date given is the month the encirclement closed and orders the stop. No address is documented for where the family sheltered during the siege itself, as distinct from the earlier Sandor Kiss arrangement.
stops.campa: The Red Army closes on the city in late December and the siege runs to the middle of February: street by street, cellar by cellar, the German and Hungarian garrison fighting from the buildings with the civilian population underneath them. In January the retreating garrison blows the Danube bridges and they go into the river. He is fourteen through the whole of it and turns fifteen the following August. No consulted source records which cellar the family used, or which district, or how close it came. All of them survive, hidden under names not their own.
suggested_refs: The destroyed Danube bridges of Budapest, blown by the retreating garrison in January 1945

stops.name: Bern, the thirty-second World Esperanto Congress
stops.date_confidence: The year is attested; the month is an ordering device, since no consulted source gives the congress dates. The research pool called the Swiss event a youth congress, which is wrong: Bern hosted the 32nd World Esperanto Congress in 1947, and the youth congress that year was at Ipswich (see the following stop). French Wikipedia, 'George Soros', states he attended the Bern world congress and then the Ipswich youth congress.
stops.campa: Hungary is communist now, the border is closing, and a seventeen-year-old with an Esperantist father applies for permission to attend a congress abroad. The thirty-second World Esperanto Congress meets at Bern, and he is allowed to go. Esperanto is both the pretext and the inheritance: his father's language, and the movement that issues the invitation a communist ministry will accept. He crosses the frontier legally, on papers in his own name, with the state's permission and its stamp. He does not come back.
suggested_refs: The 32nd Universala Kongreso de Esperanto, Bern, 1947

stops.name: Ipswich, the third International Youth Congress
stops.date_confidence: The 3rd Internacia Junulara Kongreso is attested at Ipswich in 1947 with roughly two hundred participants (Wikipedia, 'International Youth Congress of Esperanto'). The month is an ordering device; the congress venue within the town is not established, so the coordinate marks Ipswich generally.
stops.campa: From Bern he travels on to England, to the third International Youth Congress of Esperanto at Ipswich, some two hundred young people in a Suffolk town two years out of the war. Two congresses, the world one at Bern and the youth one here, are the whole of his exit route out of Hungary. He does not return to Budapest and he will not live under communist rule again. England in 1947 is rationed, coal-short and poor, and it has a university in London that will take him. He is seventeen. He stays.
suggested_refs: The 3rd Internacia Junulara Kongreso, Ipswich, 1947

stops.name: London School of Economics, Houghton Street: Popper
stops.date_confidence: Enrolment 1947, BSc in philosophy 1951, MSc 1954: attested. The month is the ordinary start of the academic year and is an ordering device. The research pool's Popper date range of 1949/1954 is unsupported and is corrected to 1947/1954 here. Popper's tutorship is attested by Wikipedia's 'Karl Popper' infobox, which lists Soros among notable students, and by the georgesoros.com biography.
stops.campa: He enrols at the London School of Economics and pays for it with work: portering on the railways, waiting in nightclubs, the ordinary poverty of a refugee student. Across those years he is taught by Karl Popper, whose The Open Society and Its Enemies had appeared in 1945, and the phrase enters him here as a piece of philosophy, forty years before it becomes a budget line. Popper's roll of notable students carries his name. He takes the BSc in philosophy in 1951 and the MSc in 1954.
stops.quote: in an open society, the role of the state is to defend the freedom of the individual; in a closed society, the role of the individual is to serve the interests of the rulers.
stops.quote_source: George Soros, 'Can Democracy Survive the Polycrisis?', georgesoros.com, 6 June 2023 (written seventy-six years after he first read Popper)
suggested_refs: Karl Popper, The Open Society and Its Enemies (1945), the source of the phrase and of the network's name

stops.name: City of London, Singer and Friedlander
stops.date_confidence: Firm and dates attested (1954-1956). Month defaulted; the coordinate marks the historic City of London financial district and not a confirmed office address.
stops.campa: He wants to be a philosopher and cannot afford to be one. The first sustained job in finance is an entry-level post at the London merchant bank Singer and Friedlander: banking, arbitrage, the mechanics of buying a thing in one market and selling it in another. The plan, as he states it for the next twenty years, is to earn enough to buy back the time to think. The bank stands two miles east of Houghton Street and in a different country. He works there from 1954 to 1956 and then leaves the country as well.
suggested_refs: Singer and Friedlander, City of London merchant bank, his first employer in finance

stops.name: New York, the Wall Street arbitrage years
stops.date_confidence: Firms and dates attested: F. M. Mayer 1956-1959, Wertheim and Co. 1959-1963, marriage to Annaliese Witschak 1960. Months defaulted. No office address located for either firm, so the coordinate marks the Wall Street district generally. The two firms are combined into one stop because their coordinates differ by two hundred metres and the working life did not.
stops.campa: He crosses to New York in 1956 intending to earn enough to return to a philosophical career. At F. M. Mayer he trades European securities; at Wertheim and Co. from 1959 he analyses them. The specialty is transatlantic. He knows what a German or a Dutch security is worth on both sides of the ocean, which almost nobody on Wall Street does, and the gap is the business. In 1960 he marries Annaliese Witschak, a German-born war orphan; three children follow, Robert, Andrea and Jonathan. As the arbitrage margins narrow through the early sixties he goes back to writing philosophy at night.
suggested_refs: F. M. Mayer and Wertheim and Co., the two Wall Street houses of his first American decade

stops.name: New York, Arnhold and S. Bleichroeder
stops.date_confidence: Firm, role and fund launches attested (vice president from 1963, First Eagle Fund 1967). Month defaulted. The 1960s office address is not located, so a midtown Manhattan marker is used.
stops.campa: Arnhold and S. Bleichroeder is an old German-Jewish house, and Henry H. Arnhold makes the Hungarian a vice president. This is the platform. In 1967 he is given the First Eagle Fund to run; he recruits Jim Rogers as his analyst, and the two of them cover markets the firm's competitors do not read. He is thirty-seven and running other people's money on his own judgment for the first time. The philosophy manuscript he has been rewriting for years, the one about reflexivity and the fallibility of the people inside a market, goes back in the drawer.
suggested_refs: The First Eagle Fund, 1967, the first fund he managed under his own name

stops.name: Willemstad, Curacao: the Double Eagle offshore
stops.date_confidence: The Curacao / Netherlands Antilles structure and the approximate four million dollars of initial capital are standard in financial histories of the fund; the SEC filing cited in the research pool was not content-verified for the 1969 detail. Soros himself is not placed in Willemstad by any consulted source: the coordinate marks the fund's jurisdiction of registration, not a visit. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: The Double Eagle Fund is organized in the Netherlands Antilles with about four million dollars, roughly a quarter of a million of it his own, so that investors who are not American can put money in without the Securities and Exchange Commission being involved. No source consulted places him on the island, in 1969 or afterwards; he is at a desk in Manhattan and stays there. What is in Willemstad is a registered name and a file of papers that make the arrangement legal, at an address on an island in the Caribbean.
suggested_refs: The Double Eagle Fund, registered in the Netherlands Antilles, 1969

stops.name: New York, Soros Fund Management and the departure
stops.date_confidence: 1970 founding and the 1973 departure with roughly twelve million dollars under management are attested. Months defaulted. The research pool dated the Quantum renaming to 1973; that is wrong. The vehicle became the Soros Fund in 1973 and took the name Quantum in 1979, and the correction is carried in the campa rather than hidden here. Original office location not confirmed, so a general Manhattan marker is used.
stops.campa: In 1970 he sets up Soros Fund Management as the company that runs the funds. In 1973, with roughly twelve million dollars under management, he leaves Bleichroeder and works on his own account. He is forty-three, running his own firm, and still telling people he intends to write. The vehicle becomes the Soros Fund that year. The name Quantum, taken from Heisenberg's uncertainty principle, does not arrive until 1979, though almost every retelling backdates it to the year he went independent.
stops.quote: My peculiarity is that I don't have a particular style of investing or, more exactly, I try to change my style to fit the conditions.
stops.quote_source: Attributed to George Soros, Soros on Soros: Staying Ahead of the Curve (1995), as compiled on Wikiquote; not verified against the primary book text in this pass
suggested_refs: The Quantum Fund, named in 1979 after Heisenberg's uncertainty principle

segments.name: The Amoral Activity, and the First Giving

stops.name: Rondebosch, the University of Cape Town scholarships
stops.date_confidence: attested. The Open Society Foundations' own South Africa page, fetched, confirms the University of Cape Town scholarship programme as his first philanthropic venture, launched in 1979. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: The first philanthropy is a scholarship fund for Black South African students at the University of Cape Town, under apartheid, in a country where their admission is the whole point of the exercise. He is forty-nine and has been rich for a decade without giving anything away in any organized manner. The method he will use for the next forty years is already in this one programme: find the closed thing, pay for the exception. Some eighty students are supported. It begins in 1979, and it is the first thing his money does that is not trading.
suggested_refs: The University of Cape Town scholarship programme, 1979, the first Soros philanthropy
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Open Society Foundations South Africa', fetched

stops.name: Washington, the Securities and Exchange Commission complaint
stops.date_confidence: [R] as to sourcing. The case is in the Commission's own record per the research pool's source list, but sec.gov returned 403 on the cited 1979 digest PDF at both www.sec.gov and sec.gov, so it was not independently verified in this pass. The coordinate is the Commission's present headquarters at 100 F Street NE; in 1979 it was at 450 Fifth Street NW, and the pool's original point corresponded to no SEC building at all. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: The Commission brings a civil market-manipulation complaint against Soros and Soros Fund Management over trading in Computer Sciences Corporation: selling before an offering to push the price down, buying afterwards to push it back up. In the same year he pays for the Cape Town scholarships, and nothing in the record consulted here connects the two or reconciles them. The case ends in a consent injunction. He admits nothing and denies nothing, which is what a consent injunction is for, and no criminal charge follows.
stops.quote: I am basically there to make money. I cannot and do not look at the social consequences of what I do.
stops.quote_source: Attributed to George Soros, CBS 60 Minutes interview with Steve Kroft, 20 December 1998, as compiled on Wikiquote; the CBS transcript page returned 404 and the quotation is unverified against the primary recording
suggested_refs: SEC v. Soros Fund Management and George Soros (1979), consent injunction over Computer Sciences Corporation trades
sources: SEC news digest, 22 May 1979 (cited in the research pool; sec.gov returned 403 in this pass)

stops.name: New York, the year the fund fell
stops.date_confidence: Loss figures and the personal crisis are consistently reported across career chronologies cross-referenced with Wikipedia's financial-events summary, but no primary filing was opened in this pass. Divorce from Annaliese 1983 and marriage to Susan Weber 1983 are attested (Wikipedia). Month defaulted; office coordinate unchanged from the general midtown marker.
stops.campa: The fund has grown to around four hundred million dollars. In 1981 it loses about twenty-two percent and the investors leave; assets fall to roughly half. It is the only losing year of the fund's first two decades, and he hands the trading to other managers for a while rather than sit at it. His first marriage breaks in the same period. He divorces Annaliese in 1983 and marries the art historian Susan Weber that year, and two more sons follow, Alexander and Gregory.
suggested_refs: The Quantum Fund's 1981 drawdown and redemptions, the only losing year of its first two decades

stops.name: Budapest, the Hungarian Academy of Sciences and the photocopiers
stops.date_confidence: attested. The Open Society Foundations history page, fetched, confirms 1984 Hungary as the network's founding national foundation. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: He comes back to Hungary as a foreign donor and negotiates a joint foundation with the Hungarian Academy of Sciences: scholarships, grants to independent cultural groups, and photocopiers. It is the first national foundation of the network, and the ones that follow are built to this pattern. The photocopiers are the substance of it. In a state that controls duplication, a machine placed in a library or a hospital or a university is a printing press the censor did not authorize. The regime accepts them because they are office equipment.
suggested_refs: The 1984 Soros Foundation joint venture with the Hungarian Academy of Sciences, first of the national foundations
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

stops.name: Beijing, the China Fund for Reform and Opening
stops.date_confidence: The 1986 founding and the 1989 closure are confirmed by the fetched Open Society Foundations history page. No office location within Beijing is established, so the coordinate marks the city. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: With a Chinese economic-reform institute he sets up the China Fund for Reform and Opening, on the Budapest pattern and three years after it. Reformist officials welcome the money; the security services do not, and read a foreign-funded grant-making body as exactly what a foreign-funded grant-making body is. Suspicion builds through 1988. The fund closes in 1989, in the same season the tanks reach Tiananmen Square. Whether it was shut down or given up, no source consulted here says.
stops.quote: I consider Mr. Xi the most dangerous enemy of open societies in the world.
stops.quote_source: George Soros, 'Xi's Dictatorship Threatens the Chinese State', The Wall Street Journal, 14 August 2021, republished at georgesoros.com and fetched there directly; written thirty-five years after the China Fund opened
suggested_refs: The China Fund for Reform and Opening, 1986-1989
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

stops.name: New York, Wall Street in October 1987
stops.date_confidence: The crash date is attested. The loss figures are not settled and are given here attributed rather than flat: Wikipedia's 'Soros Fund Management' article gives about 800 million dollars lost on Japanese stocks before Black Monday, while the roughly 300 million figure in wide circulation refers specifically to the forced liquidation of S&P futures during the crash. The fund's positive close for 1987 is consistently reported. The research pool cited a georgesoros.com diary URL dated 19 October 1987 that does not resolve; the diary is a section of The Alchemy of Finance and the book is cited instead.
stops.campa: His investment diary, published that year inside The Alchemy of Finance, has argued that American markets will hold and Japanese markets will break. In October the opposite happens. He has printed his reasoning in advance, under his own name, and is publicly and expensively wrong. The theory printed in the same book predicts exactly that of a man inside a market. Reported losses vary with the teller: roughly eight hundred million dollars on Japanese stocks before the crash, and about three hundred million in the forced liquidation of S&P futures during it. The fund closes 1987 up.
stops.quote: Equilibrium itself has rarely been observed in real life-market prices have a notorious habit of fluctuating
stops.quote_source: George Soros, The Crisis of Global Capitalism: Open Society Endangered (PublicAffairs, 1998), located by full-text search; Wikiquote misattributes the sentence to The Alchemy of Finance, where a full-text search of the complete scan returns no hits
suggested_refs: George Soros, The Alchemy of Finance (1987), whose real-time investment diary was published before the October crash
sources: George Soros, The Alchemy of Finance (1987)

stops.name: Warsaw, the Stefan Batory Foundation
stops.date_confidence: Founding year and mission confirmed by the fetched Open Society Foundations history page. Month defaulted. The coordinate marks central Warsaw and not the foundation's street address.
stops.campa: The Stefan Batory Foundation opens in Poland while the communist government is still in place, funding rule of law, civic organizations, and the argument for a European Poland. It is named for a sixteenth-century Polish king. The name says the money is not foreign. The money is foreign. Within two years the government it was founded under is gone and the foundation is not. Warsaw is the second national foundation after Budapest, built the same way: local board, local staff, money from New York.
suggested_refs: The Stefan Batory Foundation, Warsaw, founded 1988
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

stops.name: Paris, boulevard Haussmann: the Societe Generale shares
stops.date_confidence: The trade and its later prosecution are well documented in French press coverage. Month defaulted. The coordinate is the bank's historic headquarters address and not necessarily the site of any 1988 meeting.
stops.campa: Societe Generale has just been privatized, and a group forming a takeover bid approaches Soros to join it. He declines the raid and then buys shares in the bank and in other newly privatized French companies on his own account. Fourteen years later a French court will call that insider trading. In 1988 it is a trade like any other, made by a man who has spent thirty years buying things in one market that another market has mispriced, and French law on the point is at this date not settled.
suggested_refs: The 1988 privatization of Societe Generale and the abortive takeover raid
sources: Le Monde, 'Societe Generale: la condamnation de George Soros confirmee en appel' (25 March 2005)

stops.name: Kyiv, the International Renaissance Foundation
stops.date_confidence: Founding year and mission attested by the fetched Open Society Foundations history page. Month defaulted; original office address not established, so a central Kyiv marker is used.
stops.campa: The International Renaissance Foundation opens in Kyiv a year and a half before Ukraine is a country. It funds education, independent media, legal reform and translation, the apparatus a state needs and does not yet have. Of all the national foundations this is the one with the longest run. Thirty-two years after it opens, Russian columns cross the border, and the organization that paid for textbooks is running humanitarian relief. It is still operating in 2022.
suggested_refs: The International Renaissance Foundation, Kyiv, founded 1990
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

stops.name: New York, ten million dollars to Eduardo Elsztain
stops.date_confidence: attested to 1990 in eduardo_elsztain.journey.json, which cites Wikipedia's 'Eduardo Elsztain'. No venue and no introducer are given in any source consulted, and the month is defaulted; the coordinate is the standing New York City pin used across the corpus rather than an office address.
stops.campa: A young Argentine named Eduardo Elsztain gets into the office in New York and asks for money to buy Buenos Aires property. Argentina is two years out of hyperinflation and its real estate is priced at nothing, which is exactly the kind of dislocation Soros has been reading in markets since the City of London. No source consulted places Soros himself in Argentina, then or later; the money travels and the man does not. Elsztain leaves with a mandate to manage roughly ten million dollars and builds a real-estate empire on it. The Buenos Aires press will call him an ex-Soros partner for the rest of his career.
suggested_refs: Buenos Aires Times, 'Ex-Soros partner surfs Argentine crisis with real estate empire' (2023)

stops.name: Prague, Central European University opens
stops.date_confidence: attested and upgraded from the research pool's [R]. Wikipedia's 'Central European University' states the university was founded in 1991 and set up in Budapest, Prague and Warsaw, with the first classes held in Prague for around a hundred students from twenty countries. The fetched Open Society Foundations history page names only Budapest for 1991, which is an omission rather than a contradiction. Month defaulted.
stops.campa: Central European University opens in Prague with about a hundred students from twenty countries, and with sites at Budapest and Warsaw as well. The purpose is stated without embarrassment: to train the scholars, lawyers and officials that post-communist societies will need and do not have, in English, on a graduate model, inside the region rather than by sending everyone west. Prague is the first campus and holds the first classes, a hundred students in a city two years out from the Velvet Revolution.
suggested_refs: Central European University, first classes at Prague, 1991
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

segments.name: The Man Who Broke the Bank of England

stops.name: London, Threadneedle Street: Black Wednesday
stops.date_confidence: attested. The coordinate is the standing Bank of England pin already carried in mayer_amschel_rothschild.journey.json and robert_maxwell.journey.json and is reproduced byte-identically. The claim that Soros alone broke the Bank is the popular exaggeration and not a fact: numerous funds were selling sterling simultaneously.
stops.campa: Quantum is short about ten billion dollars of sterling. Through the day the Treasury spends reserves defending the pound and raises interest rates to hold it inside the European Exchange Rate Mechanism, and by evening it gives up and suspends sterling from the mechanism. From the evening of the sixteenth of September he is the man who broke the Bank of England, and nothing he does afterwards outruns the phrase. Many funds were selling sterling that week; the epithet attaches to one of them. Quantum's profit on the immediate trade is reported near a billion dollars.
suggested_refs: Britain's last currency crisis, in An Exchange Rate History of the United Kingdom (Cambridge)
sources: Cambridge, An Exchange Rate History of the United Kingdom, 'Britain's Last Currency Crisis'

stops.name: Budapest, Nador utca 9: the university comes home
stops.date_confidence: Corrected from the research pool, which dated the Nador utca campus to 1991. Wikipedia's 'Central European University' puts the relocation from Prague to Budapest in January 1993; the Prague presence ended in 1997. The Budapest campus as the university's main campus is confirmed by the fetched Open Society Foundations history page.
stops.campa: In January the university moves its centre from Prague to Budapest, to Nador utca in the fifth district, a short walk from the Danube and from the Academy that took his photocopiers nine years earlier. He left this city at seventeen on an Esperanto congress permit; it now holds his university and his foundation. The Prague presence winds down and ends in 1997. Budapest is the main campus for the next twenty-five years, long enough for everyone to forget it was the second one.
suggested_refs: Central European University, Nador utca 9, Budapest, main campus from January 1993
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched

stops.name: Moscow, the International Science Foundation
stops.date_confidence: Year corrected from the research pool's 1992. The fetched Open Society Foundations history page places the International Science Foundation in 1993 and confirms the 200 million dollar figure. Month defaulted. The cited Cambridge journal article on Soros and post-Soviet education reform was not fetched for content in this pass.
stops.campa: The Soviet Union is gone and its scientific establishment is unpaid. The name Soros becomes a household word in Russia years before it is one in most of America, and this is why: two hundred million dollars committed to the International Science Foundation, the largest private intervention any foreigner has made in Russian intellectual life. Emergency grants go to individual researchers, along with equipment, journal subscriptions, and electronic connectivity for institutes that have none. The money keeps people at their benches instead of emigrating or leaving science altogether.
suggested_refs: The International Science Foundation, 1993, and its emergency grants to former Soviet scientists
sources: Open Society Foundations, 'Who We Are: Our History', fetched
Contemporary European History, 'Almighty Soros? Education Reform and Foreign Influence in Post-Soviet Russia' (not fetched)

stops.name: New York, the Open Society Institute
stops.date_confidence: attested. Wikipedia's 'Open Society Foundations' gives April 1993 for the Institute's creation and Aryeh Neier's presidency as 1993-2012. Original New York office address not confirmed.
stops.campa: By 1993 there are national foundations in more countries than one man can telephone, and the Open Society Institute is created in New York to hold them together.
